question: In 2022, the Union Ministry of Electronics and IT approved the greenfield Electronic Manufacturing Cluster (EMC) in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **In 2022, the Union Ministry of Electronics and IT **approved the greenfield** Electronic Manufacturing Cluster (EMC) **in** Maharashtra.** This means that a new electronic manufacturing cluster will be established in Maharashtra, which will **boost the electronics industry in the state.**
